radius.label: Corner rounding
radius.description: How round panels, cards and controls are. Pressed and active controls round a little further.

immersion.label: Xianxia immersion
immersion.description: How much of the ink-wash world shows: drifting mist, particles and textures behind panels, or ornament on the frame only.

paper.label: Paper
paper.description: The frame and panels as frosted paper: translucent over a soft blur of what's behind, with paper fibre. Text and controls stay solid.
